subject: Newcomer sandbox sweetener and commit path request
messages:
From: Sam Cheng <sam@brightarclabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Nguyen <tara@brightarclabs.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Newcomer sandbox sweetener + commit path

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about Redwood's latency profile and the dedicated conversion story. We're wrapping up an internal decision to move a proof-of-concept for our agent orchestration into production early next year and want to make sure the economics line up.

Quick ask: for our 8-person engineering team at BrightArc Labs, could Redwood consider a temporary onboarding sweetener (extra sandbox credits) for the first 60 days plus a clear path to switch to Dedicated with a step-down discount if we convert to a 12-month commitment by end of Q1?

High level constraints from our side:
- We need ~150k token-month equivalent for the first 2 months to run benchmarks and user trials.
- We can consider a paid reserved commit after the trial, but budget is tight until we close our next funding tranche.

If you can provide: (a) a one-off promo credit allocation for 60 days, (b) a conversion discount schedule tied to a 12-month commit, and (c) an outline of billing / invoice timing, we can get legal and finance aligned quickly.

Attached is a short one-pager on our rollout plan (attachment referenced). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sam Cheng
Co-founder & Head of Platform
BrightArc Labs

Attachment: BrightArc-rollout.pdf (summary one-pager)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cheng <sam@brightarclabs.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Newcomer sandbox sweetener + commit path

Sam — great to hear and congrats on the momentum. I looped in Ben (programs) and Marissa (partners) to make sure we can structure something that both helps you validate quickly and keeps the path to Dedicated straightforward.

Proposed starting point from Redwood:
- 150k tokens/month credit for 60 days (applied as promo credits).
- If BrightArc signs a 12-month Dedicated commitment by 2028-03-31, we can offer:
  • 18% off list for the first 6 months of the commitment (applied as invoice credit)
  • An onboarding engineering hour credit (10 hours) to assist with KV cache tuning and deployment checklist.
- Billing: promo credits will be applied against hosting usage; once converted to Dedicated we will invoice monthly against the committed spend with a 30-day net term.

Two items I need from you to fast-track:
1) Confirm the start date for the 60-day window (we recommend activating within two weeks).
2) Share the billing contact and PO cadence so I can prefill the SOW.

I'll attach a draft Mutual Action Plan and SOW for your review. Ben / Marissa — any internal guardrails we should flag?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MutualActionPlan.xlsx; SOW-draft.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Newcomer sandbox sweetener + commit path — quick internal

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Sam's request. Quick context and asks:
- Client: BrightArc Labs (seed-stage, engineering-heavy). Wants 150k tokens/mo x 60 days promo credits to run POC.
- Conversion trigger: sign 12mo Dedicated by 3/31/2028. Proposal: 18% off list for first 6 months + 10 hrs eng support.

Questions:
- Ben: is the 150k x 60d promo within program limits for a new accelerator / newcomer sweetener? If not, what's a sanctioned cap and eskalation path?
- Marissa: any partner-led co-funding or reseller carveouts we should consider if BrightArc wants to route via a channel later?

I'm proposing we approve the promo conditional on a signed Mutual Action Plan and marketing opt-in. If finance needs a commit threshold for the conversion discount to be applied, we can set that in the MAP.

Thanks — can we turn around a final answer by EOD?

—Kim

Subject: Re: Request: Newcomer sandbox sweetener + commit path

Kimberly — this looks good and thank you for moving quickly. BrightArc is happy to accept the 60-day 150k/month promo. We can commit to a 12-month Dedicated conversion conversation by 2028-03-31; once we have the final SOW and MAP we will route to our CFO for approval.

Start date: please activate the promo credits on 2027-10-25. Billing contact: Tara Nguyen, tara@brightarclabs.com, +1 (415) 555-0123. PO cadence: monthly invoices, CFO prefers net-30.

Two small asks before we sign:
1) Can the conversion discount be expressed in the MAP as an explicit $ credit example (e.g., if committed spend = $X, then first 6 months discount = 18% of invoiced amount up to $Y)? That will help our procurement team model the numbers.
2) We prefer DocuSign for signatures — please send the MAP + SOW via DocuSign when ready.

If you can get the MAP/SOW to us by close of week, we'll try to have CFO review within 5 business days.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get tests running.

Best,
Sam
Co-founder & Head of Platform
BrightArc Labs
